system.description:
Cunei Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Rare, Earth. 1 item slot. Uses: 1.

A perfectly carved marble cube. So perfect that even touching it alters and warps its perfection.

Toss Cube (Action): When you have this item equipped in a readied item slot, you may toss it up to 30ft into the battlefield. All creatures within 15ft of the cube make Wiles Checks against 3 levels of Taunt to the cube. Any creature that is Cunei makes Wiles Checks against 6 levels of Taunt against the cube. When any creature touches the Cube, all creatures lose Taunt.

Rulebook p.46.
